cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(AndroidEmuGL LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
option(EMUGL_GENERATOR_ONLY "Only build the native protocol generator" OFF)
set(U ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/upstream)
set(G ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated)
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${G})
if(NOT EMUGEN)
  if(CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Set EMUGEN to the native host generator")
  endif()
  add_executable(emugen ${U}/host/tools/emugen/ApiGen.cpp ${U}/host/tools/emugen/EntryPoint.cpp ${U}/host/tools/emugen/main.cpp ${U}/host/tools/emugen/Parser.cpp ${U}/host/tools/emugen/strUtils.cpp ${U}/host/tools/emugen/TypeFactory.cpp)
  set(EMUGEN $<TARGET_FILE:emugen>)
  set(GEN_DEP emugen)
endif()
if(EMUGL_GENERATOR_ONLY)
  return()
endif()
set(SOURCES)
set(INCLUDES ${G} ${U}/shared ${U}/shared/OpenglCodecCommon ${U}/host/include/libOpenglRender ${U}/host/libs/libOpenglRender ${U}/host/libs/Translator/include)
foreach(pair "GLESv1_dec:gles1" "GLESv2_dec:gles2" "renderControl_dec:renderControl")
  string(REPLACE ":" ";" parts ${pair})
  list(GET parts 0 dir)
  list(GET parts 1 api)
  set(input ${U}/host/libs/${dir})
  list(APPEND INCLUDES ${input})
  set(outputs)
  foreach(suffix _dec.cpp _dec.h _opcodes.h _server_context.h _server_context.cpp)
    list(APPEND outputs ${G}/${api}${suffix})
  endforeach()
  add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${outputs} COMMAND ${EMUGEN} -D ${G} -i ${input} ${api} DEPENDS ${GEN_DEP} ${input}/${api}.in ${input}/${api}.attrib ${input}/${api}.types VERBATIM)
  list(APPEND SOURCES ${outputs})
endforeach()
foreach(name id_to_object_map lazy_instance message_channel pod_vector shared_library smart_ptr thread_store thread_pthread)
  list(APPEND SOURCES ${U}/shared/emugl/common/${name}.cpp)
endforeach()
foreach(name GLClientState GLSharedGroup glUtils TimeUtils)
  list(APPEND SOURCES ${U}/shared/OpenglCodecCommon/${name}.cpp)
endforeach()
foreach(name ColorBuffer FbConfig FrameBuffer ReadBuffer RenderContext RenderControl RenderThread RenderThreadInfo TextureDraw WindowSurface)
  list(APPEND SOURCES ${U}/host/libs/libOpenglRender/${name}.cpp)
endforeach()
list(APPEND SOURCES ${U}/host/libs/GLESv1_dec/GLESv1Decoder.cpp ${U}/host/libs/GLESv2_dec/GLESv2Decoder.cpp)
add_library(androidemugl STATIC ${SOURCES} Backend.cpp Bridge.cpp)
target_include_directories(androidemugl PRIVATE ${INCLUDES} PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_compile_options(androidemugl PRIVATE -Wno-format -Wno-deprecated-declarations)

# Diagnostic escape hatch for the Android window -> ColorBuffer handoff.
# Keep OFF for normal builds; turn ON only to bypass the reverse EGLImage path.
option(EMUGL_FORCE_CPU_COLORBUFFER_BLIT
       "Use synchronous CPU readback/upload instead of reverse EGLImage blit" OFF)
if(EMUGL_FORCE_CPU_COLORBUFFER_BLIT)
  target_compile_definitions(androidemugl PRIVATE AE_FORCE_CPU_COLORBUFFER_BLIT=1)
endif()

option(EMUGL_SANITIZE "Instrument renderer memory and undefined behavior" OFF)
if(EMUGL_SANITIZE)
  target_compile_options(androidemugl PUBLIC -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
  target_link_options(androidemugl PUBLIC -fsanitize=address,undefined)
endif()
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(androidemugl PUBLIC Threads::Threads ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
if(APPLE)
  # Link the EGL implementation in GLESv2, not WebKit's filename-based EGL shim.
  if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "iOS" AND NOT ANGLE_GLES_LIBRARY)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Set ANGLE_GLES_LIBRARY to the iOS ANGLE build's libGLESv2.dylib (run scripts/build_qemu_ios.sh)")
  endif()
  find_library(ANGLE_GLES_LIBRARY NAMES GLESv2 REQUIRED)
  if(NOT IS_ABSOLUTE "${ANGLE_GLES_LIBRARY}" OR NOT EXISTS "${ANGLE_GLES_LIBRARY}" OR IS_DIRECTORY "${ANGLE_GLES_LIBRARY}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "ANGLE_GLES_LIBRARY must name an existing ANGLE GLES library: ${ANGLE_GLES_LIBRARY}")
  endif()
  target_link_libraries(androidemugl PUBLIC "${ANGLE_GLES_LIBRARY}")
  target_compile_definitions(androidemugl PRIVATE AE_ANGLE_METAL=1)
endif()
install(TARGETS androidemugl ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib)
install(FILES Bridge.h DESTINATION include)

set(AE_GPU_LIBS "-landroidemugl -lstdc++ -ldl -lpthread")
if(APPLE)
  set(AE_GPU_LIBS "-landroidemugl -lGLESv2 -lc++")
endif()
configure_file(androidemugl.pc.in androidemugl.pc @ONLY)
install(FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/androidemugl.pc DESTINATION lib/pkgconfig)
option(EMUGL_TESTS "Build actual EGL/GLES wire protocol tests" OFF)
# Exercise the same image handoff barriers in host tests as in the Metal build.
if(APPLE OR EMUGL_TESTS)
  target_compile_definitions(androidemugl PRIVATE AE_SYNC_SHARED_IMAGES=1)
endif()
if(EMUGL_TESTS)
  enable_testing()
  # Compile the actual Metal resolver with fake ANGLE exports on every host.
  # The public libEGL shim deliberately aborts if the backend enters it.
  add_executable(angle_backend_tests ../../Tests/ANGLEBackendTests.cpp Backend.cpp
    ${G}/gles1_server_context.cpp ${G}/gles2_server_context.cpp)
  target_include_directories(angle_backend_tests PRIVATE ${INCLUDES} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
  target_compile_definitions(angle_backend_tests PRIVATE AE_ANGLE_METAL=1)
  add_test(NAME angle_backend_resolution COMMAND angle_backend_tests)
  add_executable(frame_post_failure_tests ../../Tests/FramePostFailureTests.cpp)
  target_include_directories(frame_post_failure_tests PRIVATE ${INCLUDES})
  target_link_libraries(frame_post_failure_tests PRIVATE androidemugl)
  add_test(NAME frame_post_failure COMMAND frame_post_failure_tests)
  add_executable(egl_image_tests ../../Tests/EGLImageTests.cpp)
  target_include_directories(egl_image_tests PRIVATE ${INCLUDES})
  target_link_libraries(egl_image_tests PRIVATE androidemugl)
  add_test(NAME egl_image_sharing COMMAND egl_image_tests)
  if(APPLE)
    add_test(NAME egl_image_same_size_orphan COMMAND egl_image_tests --same-size)
  endif()
  add_executable(gpu_tests ../../Tests/GPUTests.cpp)
  target_include_directories(gpu_tests PRIVATE ${G})
  target_link_libraries(gpu_tests PRIVATE androidemugl)
  add_test(NAME gpu_wire_render COMMAND gpu_tests)
  add_test(NAME gpu_invalid_dimensions COMMAND gpu_tests --invalid-dimensions)
  if(NOT APPLE)
    add_test(NAME gpu_unavailable_egl COMMAND gpu_tests --unavailable-egl)
    set_tests_properties(gpu_unavailable_egl PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT "__EGL_VENDOR_LIBRARY_FILENAMES=/nonexistent-emugl-vendor.json")
  endif()
  set_tests_properties(gpu_wire_render PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 60)
endif()
